scripts.text: You're carrying too many items. Please make some room in your bag first.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了。请先腾出一些背包空间。

scripts.text: You're overweight with items. Please lose some item weight first.
scripts.translation: 你的物品负重超限了。请先丢弃一些物品。

scripts.text: I'm not here to babysit. Get lost!
scripts.translation: 我可不是来照看小孩的。走开！

scripts.text: Ha ha, are you also seeking new knowledge?
scripts.translation: 哈哈，你也在追求新的知识吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but my knowledge doesn't concern you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我的知识和你无关。

scripts.text: Well, you've met all the qualifications except one: you need the Release spell.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你只差一项条件：必须学会释放术。

scripts.text: Learn the spell first. I've got so many things to tell you.
scripts.translation: 先去学会那个技能。我有很多事情要告诉你。

scripts.text: Congratulations on entering a brand new world of magic.
scripts.translation: 恭喜你踏入全新的魔法世界。

scripts.text: We magic practitioners are always thirsty for new knowledge and power.
scripts.translation: 我们魔法师总是渴求新的知识与力量。

scripts.text: We endure great hardship and pain to achieve what we want. When we finally do, the sense of accomplishment defies description. That's why both you and I have chosen the way of magic.
scripts.translation: 为了达成目标，我们甘愿承受艰辛与痛苦。成功时的成就感难以言喻。这就是你我选择魔法之路的原因。

scripts.text: By the way, what brings you to me today?
scripts.translation: 对了，你今天来找我有什么事？

scripts.text: Do you know the Reading Spell Book?
Can I have a Magic Book?
Can I use the Reading Spell Book without the Freezing Spell?
scripts.translation: 没有“魔法保存”也能使用“阅读魔法书”吗？

scripts.text: Reading Spell Book literally means 'read a spell book.' Do you know how to use Magic Books?
scripts.translation: ‘阅读魔法书’顾名思义就是读魔法书。你知道如何使用魔法书吗？

scripts.text: Well then, you don't need an additional lecture.
scripts.translation: 既然如此，就不需要我再讲解了。

scripts.text: Magic Books are an advanced type of magic scroll. While spells on scrolls disappear after one use, the ones in Magic Books can be cast multiple times.
scripts.translation: 魔法书是更高级的魔法卷轴。卷轴上的法术使用一次就会消失，而魔法书中的法术可以施放多次。

scripts.text: Let's compare a spell on a scroll to a wire. When the wire is used to open a door or do something else, it's bent and crushed, losing its original shape. A spell from a Magic Book is more like a shape memory alloy.
scripts.translation: 我们把卷轴上的法术比作一根金属丝。用它开门或做其他事后，金属丝会弯折变形，失去原样。魔法书里的法术则更像形状记忆合金。

scripts.text: Huh, don't you now what shape memory alloy is? Eh, just remember this: a wire made from shape memory alloy restores its shape over time.
scripts.translation: 咦，你不知道什么是形状记忆合金吗？算了，记住就好：这种合金制成的金属丝会随时间恢复原状。

scripts.text: Like the alloy, a spell on a Magic Book remains after a use, although reusing the spell has a downtime for its restoration.
scripts.translation: 和合金一样，魔法书里的法术使用后仍会保留，不过再次使用前需要等待它恢复。

scripts.text: ...Oh, I didn't mean to talk for too long. Anyways, you can use Magic Books to cast spells that you've learned. Its concept is different from normal spells.
scripts.translation: ...哦，我讲得有点多了。总之，魔法书可以用来施放你已经学会的法术，原理和普通法术不同。

scripts.text: Why do you have to write your existing spells in Magic Books, you asked?
scripts.translation: 你问为什么要把已学会的法术写进魔法书？

scripts.text: That's a good question. It's related to Magic Binding.
scripts.translation: 问得好。这和魔法封印有关。

scripts.text: You already learned Release, which allows you to hold the energy of the four different elements before the actual casting. Magic Binding is similar to Release.
scripts.translation: 你已经学会释放术，可以在施法前储存四种元素的能量。魔法封印与释放术类似。

scripts.text: Since you've learned Release, you're capable of using Magic Binding as well. Well, let's talk about that later.
scripts.translation: 既然你学会了释放术，也就能使用魔法封印。这个之后再谈。

scripts.text: You know how to hold an existing spell, and then cast it at a desired timing via Release.
scripts.translation: 你知道如何储存已经掌握的法术，再通过释放术在需要时施放。

scripts.text: Carrying the globes of the four elements is also related to Magic Binding.
scripts.translation: 携带四种元素的元素球也与魔法封印有关。

scripts.text: As you know, the four elements are Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth. Being able to employ them freely is the essential principle of magic.
scripts.translation: 如你所知，四大元素是火、水、风、地。能够自由运用它们，是魔法的基本原理。

scripts.text: We Humans use torches to keep fire, fans to blow wind, and bowls to hold water. We also use clay to make earthenware.
scripts.translation: 人类用火把保存火焰，用扇子生风，用碗盛水，也用黏土制作陶器。

scripts.text: Those activities may differ from magic, but both are the same in the sense of employing the four elements.
scripts.translation: 这些行为虽然与魔法不同，但本质上都是在运用四大元素。

scripts.text: When you use complex magic spells to summon a storm, drop lightning, or burn an area, that consumes a lot of your energy, both physically and mentally.
scripts.translation: 施展召唤风暴、降下雷电或焚烧区域等复杂法术，会大量消耗体力和精神力。

scripts.text: When you fail to bind such powerful magic spells or fail to control them, you can receive irreparable damage to your mind and body.
scripts.translation: 如果无法封印或控制如此强大的法术，你的身心都可能受到无法弥补的伤害。

scripts.text: That's why we use Magic Books to reduce that burden. It helps summon pre-cast spells while you're focusing on binding their magic power.
scripts.translation: 因此我们使用魔法书来减轻负担。它能协助你召唤预先准备好的法术，同时集中精神封印魔力。

scripts.text: There's one downside though: Magic Books cannot be used for spells that you haven't learned.
scripts.translation: 不过魔法书有个缺点：你无法使用尚未学会的法术。

scripts.text: As I said earlier, spells in Magic Books tend to go back to what they are.
scripts.translation: 正如我之前所说，魔法书里的法术会逐渐恢复原状。

scripts.text: That said, as a Circler, you cannot change or create spells in Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 也就是说，作为封印师，你无法更改或创造魔法书中的法术。

scripts.text: Even if you create one, its power will be beyond your capacity.
scripts.translation: 即使创造出来，它的力量也会超出你的掌控。

scripts.text: In order to use the Reading Spell Book, you must learn the Freezing Spell to bind magic.
scripts.translation: 想使用阅读魔法书，必须先学会用来封印魔法的冻结术。

scripts.text: The Freezing Spell is used for Magic Binding. It helps you to insert a magic spell to a circle.
scripts.translation: 冻结术用于魔法封印，能帮助你把法术封入魔法阵。

scripts.text: Circles of magic work organically with each other. When you use the Freezing Spell to bind a spell, the spell won't activate until you cast the release spell.
scripts.translation: 魔法阵彼此有机相连。使用冻结术封印法术后，法术会保持未发动状态，直到你施放释放术。

scripts.text: Of course, binding a spell continuously consumes your mana, but it consumes less mana than conventional magic spells.
scripts.translation: 封印法术当然会持续消耗魔力，不过比普通施法消耗得少。

scripts.text: Magic Binding becomes more difficult when you use more powerful magic spells.
scripts.translation: 法术越强，魔法封印就越困难。

scripts.text: For weak spells, you can bind two to three of them with your circle. For more powerful spells, maybe one or two is possible.
scripts.translation: 较弱的法术可以在魔法阵中封印两到三个，较强的法术可能只能封印一两个。

scripts.text: That all depends on your ability to control your spells. You'll have to try and experience Magic Binding after you first learn it to really understand.
scripts.translation: 这完全取决于你控制法术的能力。学会魔法封印后，你得亲自尝试才能真正理解。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I only have Magic Books for beginners, but they're obviously not suitable for you. Do you still want one?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我这里只有初学者用的魔法书，显然不适合你。你还要吗？

scripts.text: Where can I find advanced books?
scripts.translation: 高级魔法书要去哪里找？

scripts.text: Please go talk to [Lea] in the Archive. Tell her that you need one of the Magic Books that I've stored in there.
scripts.translation: 请去档案室找[莉亚]，告诉她你需要我存放在那里的魔法书。

scripts.text: For your information, she won't give it to you without anything in return. Expect her to ask you for something!
scripts.translation: 先提醒你，她不会白白把书给你。她肯定会要求你拿东西交换！

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but our management has recently decided to limit the availability of Magic Books for Multi Circlers. It's because their numbers are increasing more quickly than we expected.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，管理层最近决定限制多重封印师取得魔法书，因为他们的人数增长得比预期更快。

scripts.text: You could find one if you try hard, but I don't have any with me.
scripts.translation: 你努力找的话或许能找到一本，但我这里没有。

scripts.text: If our management releases the restriction, you'll be the first one to know. Don't worry.
scripts.translation: 管理层解除限制后，你会第一个知道，别担心。

scripts.text: Nothing will happen when you try to bind magic without using Magic Binding because you have nothing to hold magic.
scripts.translation: 没有使用魔法封印就尝试封印魔法，不会发生任何事，因为你没有东西来储存魔力。

scripts.text: It's like water that needs a bowl to stay in place.
scripts.translation: 这就像水需要碗才能盛住一样。

scripts.text: The problem is when you try to forcefully cast a spell that you haven't learned. It'll definitely backfire on you.
scripts.translation: 问题在于，你要是强行施放尚未学会的法术，一定会遭到反噬。

scripts.text: Of course, the damage won't be severe: you'll fall asleep or be thrown into confusion. This is all because there's a conflict between your Magic Book and the force of Magic Binding when you're trying to summon and hold a unlearned spell.
scripts.translation: 当然，伤害不会太严重：你可能会睡着或陷入混乱。这是因为你试图召唤并储存未学会的法术时，魔法书与魔法封印的力量发生了冲突。

scripts.text: Don't try it out just to see what happens for yourself! Falling asleep while casting a spell? There's nothing more humiliating than that to magic practitioners like us.
scripts.translation: 可别为了好奇亲自试试！施法时睡着？对我们魔法师来说，没有比这更丢脸的事了。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but could you ask someone else? I'm kind of busy right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你能去问问别人吗？我现在有点忙。

scripts.text: Huh, are you looking for the Ultimate Magic Book? Who sent you?
scripts.translation: 咦，你在找究极魔法书吗？是谁派你来的？

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but there's not much information left about the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，关于究极魔法书的资料所剩无几。

scripts.text: A few scholars in the Midgard Continent once tried to collect ancient Magic Books and reproduce that book, but...
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特大陆的几位学者曾试图收集古代魔法书并复原那本书，不过...

scripts.text: Oh yes, perhaps he might know something.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，也许他知道些什么。

scripts.text: Yes, I knew this was coming!
scripts.translation: 好啊，我就知道你会这么说！

scripts.text: My brother is just like you. He's very interested in recreating the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 我弟弟和你一样，对复原究极魔法书很感兴趣。

scripts.text: He's been taking a great interest in the ancient Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 他一直对古代魔法书很感兴趣。

scripts.text: I didn't support him or give him any advice for his research since I thought he'd give on it pretty quickly, but...
scripts.translation: 我原以为他很快就会放弃，所以没有支持他的研究，也没给过建议，不过...

scripts.text: If he's discovered anything useful, maybe it can helpful to you.
scripts.translation: 如果他发现了什么有用的信息，或许能帮到你。

scripts.text: I've heard that he's near the Expedition Camp beyond the Dimensional Rift to seek information about the ancient Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 听说他为了寻找古代魔法书的线索，去了次元裂缝另一侧的远征营地附近。

scripts.text: If you want to see him, you should prepare for a long journey.
scripts.translation: 如果你想见他，最好为长途旅行做好准备。

scripts.text: Galfos is near the Expedition Camp beyond the Dimensional Rift.
scripts.translation: 加尔弗斯就在次元裂缝另一侧的远征营地附近。

scripts.text: If you want to see him, you should prepare for a long journey.
scripts.translation: 如果你想见他，最好为长途旅行做好准备。

scripts.text: Ha ha, I'm sorry, but you should focus on strengthening your body rather than creating Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，抱歉，你应该专心锻炼身体，而不是制作魔法书。

scripts.text: You're carrying too many items. Please make some room in your bag first.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了。请先腾出一些背包空间。

scripts.text: You're overweight with items. Please lose some item weight first.
scripts.translation: 你的物品负重超限了。请先丢弃一些物品。

scripts.text: Master Velofos asked me to bring his Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 维洛佛斯大师让我来拿他的魔法书。

scripts.text: I want the Intermediate Magic Books.
I want the Superior Magic Books.
I want the Ultimate Magic Books.
Ah, so you want the Intermediate Magic Books. If you pay a ^4d4dffloan deposit of 100,000z^000000, we will lend you an Intermediate Magic Books.
scripts.translation: 啊，你想借中级魔法书。支付^4d4dff100,000Z借书押金^000000后，我们就会借给你一本。

scripts.text: What kind of Magic Book do you want?
You already have that Magic Book. You can't borrow a new book until you return the current one.
scripts.translation: 你已经借了那本魔法书。归还当前这本之前，不能再借新的。

scripts.text: Don't you know how many others would want the book you already have? It's a bit selfish to want more than one, you know.
scripts.translation: 你知道有多少人想借你手上的那本书吗？还想多借一本，未免太自私了吧。

scripts.text: Thank you for your deposit. The book's return date is written on the lending card on the back cover of the book. Please try not to lose or damage the book and avoid paying compensation.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的押金。归还日期写在书背面的借阅卡上。请不要遗失或损坏书籍，以免赔偿。

scripts.text: The Intermediate and Superior Magic Books must be returned upon borrowing the Ultimate Magic Book. Remember that you're just borrowing them, so make sure you take good care of those books.
scripts.translation: 借阅究极魔法书时，必须归还中级和高级魔法书。记住这些只是借来的，请好好保管。

scripts.text: The ^4d4dffloan deposit is 100,000z^000000. The deposit has adjusted as the Magic Book has changed.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff借书押金为100,000Z^000000。押金已根据魔法书种类调整。

scripts.text: Oh, do you want the Superior Magic Books? The policy has been changed to accept loan deposits unconditionally, instead of the existing demanding loan conditions.
scripts.translation: 哦，你想借高级魔法书吗？借阅政策已经变更，现在无条件收取押金，不再要求原先那些繁琐条件。

scripts.text: The Superior Magic Book ^4d4dffloan deposit is 500,000z^000000.
scripts.translation: 高级魔法书的^4d4dff借书押金为500,000Z^000000。

scripts.text: What kind of Magic Book do you want?
You already have that Magic Book. You can't borrow a new book until you return the current one.
scripts.translation: 你已经借了那本魔法书。归还当前这本之前，不能再借新的。

scripts.text: Don't you know how many others would want the book you already have? It's a bit selfish to want more than one, you know.
scripts.translation: 你知道有多少人想借你手上的那本书吗？还想多借一本，未免太自私了吧。

scripts.text: Thank you for your deposit. The book's return date is written on the lending card on the back cover of the book. Please try not to lose or damage the book and avoid paying compensation.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的押金。归还日期写在书背面的借阅卡上。请不要遗失或损坏书籍，以免赔偿。

scripts.text: The Intermediate and Superior Magic Books must be returned upon borrowing the Ultimate Magic Book. Remember that you're just borrowing them, so make sure you take good care of those books.
scripts.translation: 借阅究极魔法书时，必须归还中级和高级魔法书。记住这些只是借来的，请好好保管。

scripts.text: The ^4d4dffloan deposit is 500,000z^000000. The deposit has adjusted as the Magic Book has changed.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff借书押金为500,000Z^000000。押金已根据魔法书种类调整。

scripts.text: Did... Did you just say the Ultimate Magic Book?
scripts.translation: 你...你刚才说的是究极魔法书吗？

scripts.text: I can't believe someone actually wants that book.
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信居然有人想要那本书。

scripts.text: Please don't say that you don't have it.
Frankly, I've never even seen the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 老实说，我连究极魔法书都没见过。

scripts.text: You should ask Master Velofos if you want to know more about that book.
scripts.translation: 想了解那本书的话，应该去问维洛弗斯大师。

scripts.text: I'm sorry that I can't help you more than that.
You should ask Master Velofos for some information about that book.
scripts.translation: 想了解那本书的消息，请去问维洛弗斯大师。

scripts.text: Well... why don't you practice a little longer before that?
scripts.translation: 嗯...在那之前，何不再多练习一阵子？

scripts.text: In order to obtain the Ultimate Magic Book, you must reach Level 140 and learn Tetera Bolt and Comet.
scripts.translation: 要取得究极魔法书，你必须达到140级，并学会特特拉闪电和彗星术。

scripts.text: That book can't be used by just anyone, you know?
scripts.translation: 那本书可不是谁都能使用的。

scripts.text: Welcome to the Magic Archive. You can read and borrow books from here under certain conditions.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到魔法档案室。满足特定条件后，你可以在这里阅读和借阅书籍。

scripts.text: You're carrying too many items. Please make some room in your bag first.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了。请先腾出一些背包空间。

scripts.text: You're overweight with items. Please lose some item weight first.
scripts.translation: 你的物品负重超限了。请先丢弃一些物品。

scripts.text: I'm not here to babysit. Get lost!
scripts.translation: 我可不是来照看小孩的。走开！

scripts.text: My right arm feels hot while my left arm feels cold. I can never get used to this weird weather!
scripts.translation: 我的右臂发烫，左臂却发冷。这怪天气我怎么也习惯不了！

scripts.text: Ah, I'll get myself in trouble if I stay here any longer. Maybe I'm already in...
scripts.translation: 啊，我再待下去就要惹麻烦了。说不定已经...

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I don't talk to people that aren't even ready for this.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不和还没准备好的人说话。

scripts.text: You look strong, but you don't seem to have any business with me.
scripts.translation: 你看起来很强壮，不过似乎没什么事找我。

scripts.text: I heard that you've studied the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 我听说你研究过终极魔法书。

scripts.text: I didn't know someone would actually take an interest in that book. Yes, I'm studying that magic book. How did you find that out?
scripts.translation: 我没想到真有人会对那本书感兴趣。没错，我正在研究那本魔法书。你怎么知道的？
你是维洛佛斯的弟弟，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm Galfos, and Velofos is my brother.
scripts.translation: 没错，我是加尔弗斯，维洛弗斯是我哥哥。

scripts.text: did the old man recommend me to you?
scripts.translation: 是那位老人把你介绍来的吗？

scripts.text: This is surprising. He never took my research very seriously. I'm glad that he finally changed his mind.
scripts.translation: 真意外。他以前从没把我的研究当回事。很高兴他终于改变想法了。

scripts.text: Heh! Your timing couldn't be better: I was looking for a test object.
scripts.translation: 嘿！你来得正好，我正需要一个测试对象。

scripts.text: Frankly, I'm only interested in creating the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 老实说，我只对制作究极魔法书感兴趣。

scripts.text: I'm not good at using magic, not to mention that I prefer fists in fighting. Nevertheless, I find Magic Books to be incredibly intriguing.
scripts.translation: 我不擅长魔法，而且更喜欢拳头解决问题。不过，我觉得魔法书非常有意思。

scripts.text: The problem is that I can't use the Ultimate Magic Book, even if I made one. That's why I can't really test it on my own.
scripts.translation: 问题是即使做出究极魔法书，我也没法使用，所以无法亲自测试。

scripts.text: That's why I've been waiting for a true magic practitioner like you that can help me test my Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 所以我一直在等像你这样的真正魔法师，帮我测试究极魔法书。

scripts.text: and I need to solve one last problem to create the Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 只差解决最后一个问题，就能制作魔法书了。

scripts.text: To make the ancient Ultimate Magic Book, I need an artifact and some spells to fuse into it.
scripts.translation: 要制作古代究极魔法书，我需要一件圣物和一些能融合其中的法术。

scripts.text: I've perfectly restored the spells based on the ancient documents, but I still have no information about the necessary artifact.
scripts.translation: 我已根据古代文献完整复原法术，但仍然找不到关于那件圣物的资料。

scripts.text: Ah, but there's a silver lining!
There's a great archive in El Dicastes, the Capital City of the Evil Giants, where all knowledge in this world is stored.
scripts.translation: 邪恶巨人的首都艾尔迪卡斯特斯有一座大型档案馆，收藏着这个世界的所有知识。

scripts.text: Maybe that's the place to find some information about the artifact for this Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 也许在那里能找到制作究极魔法书所需圣物的资料。

scripts.text: You know what to do, don't you? Find information about the artifact in the El Dicastes archive, using everything in your power.
scripts.translation: 你知道该怎么做吧？尽你所能，在艾尔迪卡斯特斯档案馆寻找圣物的资料。

scripts.text: Afterwards, create and bring me the artifact. We'll talk about creating the Magic Book afterwards.
scripts.translation: 然后制作并把圣物带给我。之后我们再谈魔法书的制作。

scripts.text: You know what to do, don't you? Find information about the artifact in the El Dicastes archive, using everything in your power.
scripts.translation: 你知道该怎么做吧？尽你所能，在艾尔迪卡斯特斯档案馆寻找圣物的资料。

scripts.text: Afterwards, create and bring me the artifact. We'll talk about creating the Magic Book afterwards.
scripts.translation: 然后制作并把圣物带给我。之后我们再谈魔法书的制作。
我已经掌握了“毁灭彗星”

scripts.text: I've mastered the zenith of Tetra Vortex.
scripts.translation: 我已经掌握了“属性漩涡”

scripts.text: Are you kidding me? You already have the book!
scripts.translation: 你在开玩笑吗？你已经有这本书了！

scripts.text: Oh my, I sense incredible energy coming from you. This is great! Now we're ready to make the Ultimate Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 天啊，我感受到你身上有惊人的能量。太好了！现在可以制作究极魔法书了。

scripts.text: There's one problem, though: I'm so broke that I don't even have enough money to buy the tools to make the book.
scripts.translation: 不过有个问题：我穷得连买制作工具的钱都没有。

scripts.text: I need at least ^0000aa500,000 zeny^000000 to buy all the necessary tools. Do you have the money?
scripts.translation: 我至少需要^0000aa500,000 Zeny^000000购买所有必要工具。你有这么多钱吗？

scripts.text: Aw, you don't? It's disappointing, but there's nothing I can do. Come back when you have enough money, okay?
scripts.translation: 啊，你没有吗？真令人失望，但我也没办法。准备好钱再回来吧。

scripts.text: Man, I almost lost my control to the incredible magic energy! Here's your Magic Book.
scripts.translation: 天啊，这惊人的魔力差点让我失控！给你魔法书。

scripts.text: Thank you for making my dream come true. Feel free to come back if you need another one of these books.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你帮我实现梦想。如果还需要这类书，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text: Hey, what did I tell you? I can't buy the tools to make the book without money!
scripts.translation: 喂，我说过什么？没钱我就买不了制作工具！

scripts.text: Are you sure that you've found something? It doesn't seem like you've learned what we need...
scripts.translation: 你确定找到资料了吗？看起来你还没弄清我们需要的东西...

scripts.text: Is there anything else you need?
I better not forget to equip my ring.
When you approach the documents, an Evil Giant that looks like the archive manager tries to call Guard Galton. You should get out of here quickly.
scripts.translation: 你靠近文件时，一个伪装成档案馆管理员的邪恶巨人似乎正要呼叫加尔顿卫兵。赶快离开这里。

scripts.text: The documents are making you feel nauseous. You should come back later after your stomach settles.
scripts.translation: 这些文件让你感到恶心。等胃舒服些再回来吧。

scripts.text: You don't feel as nauseous anymore. It should be safe to proceed now.
scripts.translation: 恶心感已经消退，现在应该可以继续了。

scripts.text: The documents in this container aren't legible. It's no use trying to read them.
scripts.translation: 容器里的文件无法辨认，读了也没用。

scripts.text: You have discovered records about magic, acceleration, and particle waves.
scripts.translation: 你发现了有关魔法、加速和粒子波的记录。

scripts.text: You have discovered records about magic, acceleration, and particle waves. These documents must be the ones that Galfos is looking for.
scripts.translation: 你发现了有关魔法、加速和粒子波的记录。这些一定就是加尔佛斯想找的文件。

scripts.text: ^660066In order to create the essence of lava, you must refine 40 Burning Hearts at the hottest place on the 2nd floor of the Thor's Volcano Dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066要制作熔岩精华，必须在托尔火山地下城2楼最炽热的地方精炼40个燃烧的心脏。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066You must do this by using the greatest power in that place. The Humans have used this method to study the acceleration of magic particles since ancient times.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066必须借助那里最强大的力量完成精炼。自古以来，人类就用这种方法研究魔力粒子的加速。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Lava Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099熔岩精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: ^660066The essence of flame can be refined on stable ground on the 1st floor of the Thor's Volcano Dungeon. 10 Love Coals are necessary to refine the essence.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066在托尔火山地下城1楼的稳定地面上可以精炼火焰精华。精炼需要10个爱情煤炭。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066According to Humans' information, this essence constitutes one of the four natural elements.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066根据人类的资料，这种精华是四大自然元素之一。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Flame Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099火焰精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: ^660066I succeeded in refining the essence of glacier deep inside the 3rd floor of the Ice Cave. If you'd like to try, prepare 10 Ice Hearts and go to the following location.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066我成功在冰洞三楼深处精炼出了冰川精华。想试试的话，准备10颗冰之心，前往下方地点。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Glacier Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099冰川精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: ^660066I was able to refine the essence of fossil from old rocks on the 2nd floor of the Mine Dungeon. So far, that place is the most stable among all the testing grounds.
scripts.translation: ^660066我在矿山地下城2楼用古老岩石精炼出了化石精华。目前那里是所有试验场中最稳定的地方。

scripts.text: If you'd like to try, prepare 10 Jubilees and go to the dungeon. Good luck.^000000
scripts.translation: 如果你想试试，就准备10个朱比利前往地下城吧。祝你好运。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Fossil Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099化石精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: ^660066In order to refine the essence of storm, I visited the Hermit's Checkerboard in Kunlun where the spirit of the wind resides.
scripts.translation: ^660066为了精炼风暴精华，我去了昆仑风之精灵栖息的隐士棋盘。

scripts.text: The refining process was easy, but I had a hard time finding the catalyst, Dragon Teeth.^000000
scripts.translation: 精炼过程很简单，但寻找催化剂龙牙却费了我好大一番功夫。^000000

scripts.text: You have discovered the ^990099Storm Essence Creation Method^000000. Please check your Quest window for more details.
scripts.translation: 你发现了^990099风暴精华制作方法^000000。详情请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: Nothing in this document looks useful.
scripts.translation: 这份文件看起来没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: You suddenly feel sick, and this nausea won't go away easily. You should try finding the documents you need later.
scripts.translation: 你突然感到一阵恶心，而且久久无法缓解。稍后再来寻找需要的文件吧。
这里看起来没什么特别的。

scripts.text: You no longer need to search this place.
You have used {0} to create ^999900{1} Essence^000000.
^008800The {0} Essence will last permanently, unless there's a problem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^008800{0}精华将永久保存，除非出了什么问题。^000000

scripts.text: ^008888You have failed to refine the essence using {0}.^000000
You've already created {0} Essence in this area.
scripts.translation: 你已经在该区域制作过{0}精华。
该区域已经有人使用过了。
